_: The report /sample-report draws for Helen, from the engine's own output. tools/check-sample-report.mjs holds that report to this file.
_how: POST .../complete on the live demo (app.blend-technologies.com, the Blend Demo tenant, embed 928d8ad4333a4dc4b13e7d86f7557526, publication a2fc5b0e-8d6d-4c68-8537-cd266d67de52), 2026-11-21, replaying the request below through the public embed API exactly as the quiz runtime does: 51 answers by their stable ids, one PUT per question, then complete. Submission a129de96-fed5-4a63-8fab-ceceebcaa0bb, recommendation ec12a57c-85c7-48fe-9e21-a23d3afe81f9, HTTP 200, 10 products from the demo catalogue. The figures below were read from that submission's rendered results page by tools/replay-sample-report.mjs (a headless browser over the live page), and each macro's colour is the bar colour it drew. The submission's country is whatever the server read from the request's origin; the embed API does not return it. The results page showed a wellness score of 98, recorded as health_score. The brand's description for each product is the first paragraph its expanded card shows; the claim, the timing sentence and the ingredients that follow it are not drawn here, as before. The page's goal pills, sub-goal pills and "Your match" dots are recorded for each product (tags, subtags, match) and the goal pills under the heading (goals, subgoals), and drawn as the webapp draws them on 2026-11-20. The products under "Other products in this range" are recorded in full under other_products.items and drawn the same way, the first nine open and the rest behind "Show N more", as the webapp does. To refresh: node tools/replay-sample-report.mjs --write helen.
